subject: Extracting data from a table and displaying few rows of it using RODBC and shiny

messages.author: b66f7d1e154bde4b
messages.subject: Extracting data from a table and displaying few rows of it using RODBC and shiny
parts:
Hi shiny users,

Thanks in advance.

I am using R-3.0.1 and shiny on Windows XP.

May I request you to assist me for the following please.

I've gone through the e-mail archive but could not get a definitive answer.

I have attached the codes. While running, I receive the following error:

> runExample("webstats")

Error in source(serverR, local = new.env(parent = .GlobalEnv)) :

K:/R-3.0.1/library/shiny/examples/webstats/server.R:1:2: unexpected input

1: {\

^

>

I can access the data outside shiny. But my intention is to access data from a table (user can select a table) within shiny to make a dynamic presentation.

Once again, thank you very much for the time you have given.

Regards,

Deb

　

ui.R

-----

library("shiny")
library("RODBC")

ch<-odbcConnect("DSN",uid="uid",pwd="pwd")
tables <- sqlTables(ch)

tables <- tables[tables$TABLE_TYPE == "TABLE", ]
odbcClose(ch)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

headerPanel("Test for RODBC"),

sidebarPanel(
selectInput("Table", "Choose a table:",
choices = tables$TABLE_NAME),
numericInput("Records", "Number of Records to view:", 25)
),

mainPanel(
tableOutput("view")
)
))

　

server.R

-----------

library("shiny")

library("RODBC")

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

output$view <- reactiveTable(function() {

ch <- odbcConnect(("DSN",uid="uid",pwd="pwd")

schema_table <- paste(input$Table, sep="")

result <- sqlQuery(ch, "select * from POPULATION")

odbcClose(ch)

head(result, n= input$Records)

})

})

In your code:
output$view <- reactiveTable(function() {
reactiveTable is deprecated. Try changing it to
output$view <- renderTable({

And it looks like an extra bracket here
ch <- odbcConnect(("DSN",uid="uid",pwd="pwd")
Still not running, but gives Data source not found error, so it will probably work for you.

messages.subject: Re: Extracting data from a table and displaying few rows of it using RODBC and shiny
parts:
Kirill,
 
Thanks for your response.
 
1. shiny version
 

Package: shiny

Type: Package

Version: 0.1.0

2. webstats
 
webstats is a subdirectory and like this: \R-3.0.1\library\shiny\examples\webstats
 
I have saved ui.R and server.R in this directory.
 
To run this, I type runExample("webstats") at the R command prompt.
 
3. reactiveTable is deprecated. Try changing it to output$view <- renderTable({
I've done that.
 
4. I have provided the new ui.R and server.R

ch <- odbcConnect("******", uid= "******", pwd= "******")

odbcQuery(ch,"SELECT table_name")

tables<-sqlGetResults(ch)

odbcClose(ch)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

headerPanel("Test for RODBC"),

sidebarPanel(

selectInput("Table", "Choose a table:",

choices = tables$TABLE_NAME),

numericInput("Records", "Number of Records to view:", 25)

),

mainPanel(

tableOutput("view")

)

))

　

server.R

-----------

library("shiny")

library("RODBC")

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

output$view <- renderTable(function() {

ch <- odbcConnect("******", uid= "******", pwd= "******")

schema_table <- paste(input$Table, sep="")

result <- sqlQuery(ch, "select * from POPULATION")

odbcClose(ch)

head(result, n= input$Records)

})

})

5. Where as outside shiny (it works well):

 

library(RODBC)

channel <- odbcConnect("******", uid="******", pwd= "******")

sqlTables(channel) # I get names of the tables

odbcClose(channel)

Once again, thank you very much for the time you have given.
 
Regards,
 
Deb
